ConnectionStrings.//PegboardDb: PostgreSQL connection. Supplied per-environment on the VPS via the ConnectionStrings__PegboardDb environment variable (kept out of source control). Left blank here on purpose.

Smtp.//Username: On the VPS the EPEGBOARD_SMTP_USERNAME machine env var is used; this is the local/default fallback.
Smtp.//Password: On the VPS the EPEGBOARD_SMTP_PASSWORD machine env var supplies this (kept out of source control). Left blank here on purpose - rotate at IONOS, never commit.

Tracking.//ScreenshotImage: Image served by the /media/{trackerId}.png open-beacon (from wwwroot/Images/<file>). site-hero.png is the epegboard.com homepage hero composite - the live session dashboard (core product) + the phone (mobile) + the 'League team insights' overlay - so outreach shows the product in action, not just the picker. Captured from the homepage by PegboardWeb's HeroScreenshotCapture E2E test.

Diagnostics.//: PegboardWeb prod diagnostics API, used by the weekly homepage-stats bake. ApiKey is supplied on the VPS via the PEGBOARD_DIAG_API_KEY env var (kept out of source - never commit, never log). StatsUrl is the canonical demo/legacy-EXCLUDED aggregate endpoint - PARKED until Platform ships it; left blank so the bake no-ops gracefully and the seeded store values are served. When the endpoint exists, set StatsUrl (or rely on BaseUrl + /api/stats).

Stats.//RefreshIntervalHours: Weekly bake interval in hours. Default 168 (1 week). Lower it locally to exercise the refresh loop.

Survey.//: Organiser and player surveys (ado:2566); see docs/survey.md. ExportKey guards GET /survey/{id}/export.csv (header X-Survey-Key). Supplied on the VPS via the Survey__ExportKey env var (kept out of source - never commit); left blank here, which makes the export 404.

DataProtection.//KeysPath: Folder for the Data Protection key ring, outside the site folder so a redeploy or app-pool recycle keeps surveys in progress valid. Set on the VPS via DataProtection__KeysPath; blank uses the ASP.NET default.
